caption: The drawing depicts a single antique kettle placed on a plain light background. The kettle is composed of a rounded body with a hinged lid, a tall and curved spout on the left, and a prominent, elevated handle on top that is dark with brass-colored attachments at each end. The main body of the kettle features hues of brass, gold, and brown with some greenish patina, suggesting it is made of metal. The kettle rests on a pedestal-like base, which supports a half-spherical lower compartment. Attached to this base is a curved, matching handle on the lower right, angled downward, which is also brass-colored with shading to indicate dimension. The drawing has no additional objects or elements besides a subtle signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Tea Kettle
